name: columbamine
summary: Protoberberine alkaloid related to berberine found in Berberis and Coptis species. Shares metabolic and anti-inflammatory signaling with berberine; less studied than parent compound.
description: Columbamine, a berberine-family alkaloid, is linked to metabolic regulation pathways that may influence glucose and lipid handling through signaling modulation.
safetyNotes: Human safety is not well established. Avoid pregnancy/breastfeeding; caution with CYP/P-gp substrates, antidiabetic drugs, and complex medication regimens.
evidence_grade_explanation: The recorded grade (limited evidence) and evidence tier (strong evidence) conflict, so the weaker signal is published pending review.
evidence_rationale: Strongest recorded design is a meta-analysis, drawn from 1 recorded study, 1 in people.
